user_query: I want to discover new music related to a specific genre. Please fetch me the tracks, albums, and details of the artist associated with the genre 'rock'. Also, provide me with the music links for the tracks and albums.

TaskList.description: Fetch new tracks associated with the genre 'rock'.
Fetch albums that belong to the genre 'rock'.
Fetch details of artists associated with the genre 'rock'.
Collect music links for the tracks fetched in step 1.
Collect music links for the albums fetched in step 2.
